name: Prime Factorization Decoupling
description: Replaced the linear global sum condition with a global product condition $G = 3^m$. Since the edge factors can only be 2, 3, or 4, unique prime factorization forces every factor to be exactly 3. This completely breaks any heuristics based on linear combinations or extremum of sums, forcing the model to use number-theoretic reasoning before it can discover the bipartite coloring equivalence.
